# Downloaded sea assets

Retrieved 2026-10-19. These assets are CC0 1.0, permitting modification and redistribution including commercial games. Source credits are retained for provenance.

## Quaternius — Animated Cute Fish Pack

- Author: Quaternius
- Official page: https://quaternius.com/packs/cutefish.html
- Official FBX folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1KvrwlLowzeF7NotE0sZ-5EkEPunvVeOC
- License: CC0 1.0 Universal, original notice in `QuaterniusCuteFish/License.txt`.
- Included FBX: Clownfish, BlueTang, ButterflyFish, CoralGrouper, Goldfish, Koi, Puffer, Shark, RoyalGramma, Anglerfish, Lionfish, Tang.
- Original colored material regions and normal/fast swimming clips are used. Generated Unity prefabs normalize forward direction and dimensions; converted Standard materials are saved separately. These are stylized low-poly models.

## Poly Haven — seabed and reef textures

- Author: Rob Tuytel (both assets).
- Sand: https://polyhaven.com/a/coast_sand_02
- Rock: https://polyhaven.com/a/rock_3
- License: CC0 1.0 Universal, https://polyhaven.com/license and https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/
- Included maps: `coast_sand_02_diff_1k.jpg`, `coast_sand_02_nor_gl_1k.jpg`, `rock_3_diff_1k.jpg`, `rock_3_nor_gl_1k.jpg`.
- Official download pattern: `https://dl.polyhaven.org/file/ph-assets/Textures/jpg/1k/{asset}/{asset}_{map}_1k.jpg`.
- Color textures use sRGB; OpenGL normals are imported as Unity normal maps. Generated Standard materials apply underwater tint and repeat tiling. No HDRI or full deep-sea scene is included.

File checksums: `SHA256SUMS.txt` in this folder.
